column7: The img tag embeds an image in a webpage.

column7: The src attribute specifies the image file location.

column7: The ul tag creates a bulleted list.

column7: The label for attribute matches the input element id.

column1: What does CSS stand for?

column7: The color property sets the foreground text colour.

column1: Which CSS layout system uses display flex?

column7: Padding is the space between content and its border.

column1: Which property adds space outside an element border?
column7: Margin creates space outside an element border.

column1: Which property rounds element corners?

column1: Which rule applies styles based on screen width?

column7: Binary search halves the search space at each step.

column7: A queue follows first in first out order.

column1: Which data structure follows LIFO?
column7: A stack follows last in first out order.

column1: Which operation adds an element to a stack?
column7: Push adds an element to the top of a stack.

column1: What is the worst-case time complexity of linear search?
column7: Linear search may inspect every element.

column7: Selection sort repeatedly selects the minimum from the unsorted portion.

column7: WHERE filters rows according to a condition.

column7: INSERT INTO adds new records to a table.

column1: Which SQL clause sorts query results?
column7: ORDER BY sorts results by one or more columns.

column1: Which key uniquely identifies a row in a table?
column7: A primary key uniquely identifies each row in a table.
